Two weeks, from your own sales data. Quantified recommendations and a simulation file. [Discover PricingDiag →](/services/pricing-diag.en.html) ::: :::::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Who is this for? **European industrial companies and mid-caps that have to decide about Japan** without being able to read the data behind the decision. Strategy, innovation and R&D teams: automotive, aerospace and defence, energy, advanced materials. The trigger is almost always the same. A Japanese player moves, a market opens, and nothing available in English settles the question. ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## My approach I go back to the data itself: patents, transactions, sales. I extract it, structure it, and interpret it in its sector context. What remains is knowing what it proves. Causal inference and Bayesian modelling separate what causes a result from what merely accompanies it, and put a number on the uncertainty that is left.
